2010.kid: The boss of dozens of masts. It checks that every piece got through the air, locks them so nobody can listen in, and sends the parcels on in a tunnel to the mobile company’s gate.
2010.nerd: The RNC: it ends RLC (ARQ, ciphering) and the radio control (RRC), steers handovers between its NodeBs and, with Direct Tunnel, sends user packets in GTP-U straight to the GGSN.

up.kid: The controller unpacks the radio envelope, unlocks the pieces and puts your parcel in a tunnel envelope addressed to the mobile company’s gate.
up.nerd: The RNC reassembles and deciphers the RLC pieces, then tunnels the IP packet in GTP-U to the GGSN; the TEID names this phone’s PDP context.

down.kid: The controller opens the tunnel envelope, locks your parcel, cuts it into radio pieces and sends them to the mast your phone is near.
down.nerd: The RNC ends the GTP-U tunnel (by TEID), ciphers and segments the packet in RLC and sends it over Iub to the phone’s NodeB.
